SELECT json_build_object(
 'readOnly',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'isolation',current_setting('transaction_isolation'),
 'timeoutsBounded',(SELECT setting::bigint BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 FROM pg_settings WHERE name='statement_timeout')
   AND (SELECT setting::bigint BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 FROM pg_settings WHERE name='lock_timeout'),
 'capturedAt',transaction_timestamp(),
 'restricted',NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolcreaterole AND NOT rolbypassrls)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x."userId"),'[]'::json) FROM (
 SELECT u.id AS "userId",coalesce(u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.erased_at IS NULL,false) AS active,
 u.erased_at IS NOT NULL AS erased,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object(
 'identity',jsonb_build_array(u.password,u.session_version,u.status,u.erased_at,
   u.email,u.user_name,u.provider,u.provider_subject,u.email_verified,
   u.email_verification_token,u.email_verification_expiry),
 'roles',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.role_id ORDER BY r.role_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=u.id),
 'permissions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.permission_id ORDER BY p.permission_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.user_permissions p WHERE p.user_id=u.id)
 )::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS "securitySha256"
 FROM public.tbl_user u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT value::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))
 LIMIT 501) x

SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x."eventId"),'[]'::json) FROM (
 SELECT o.event_id AS "eventId",o.recipient_id AS "recipientId",'event-performer' AS pipeline,
 o.status::text AS status,o.lease_until AS "leaseUntil",false AS "sourceCurrent",
 'UNKNOWN' AS "externalOutcome",
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_notification_receipt r WHERE r.source_event_id=o.event_id AND r.recipient_id=o.recipient_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_notification n WHERE n.source_event_id=o.event_id AND n.recipient_id=o.recipient_id)
 THEN 'RECORDED'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_notification_receipt r WHERE r.source_event_id=o.event_id)
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_notification n WHERE n.source_event_id=o.event_id)
 THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'ABSENT' END AS receipt,
 encode(sha256(convert_to((to_jsonb(o)-ARRAY['status','attempt_count','next_attempt_at',
 'lease_owner','lease_until','last_error_type','published_at','created_at','updated_at'])::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS "intentSha256"
 FROM public.tbl_event_performer_notification_outbox o WHERE o.event_id IN (SELECT value::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))
 LIMIT 501) x

SELECT to_json(encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object(
 'roles',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.tbl_role r),
 'permissions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.tbl_permissions p),
 'rolePermissions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rp) ORDER BY rp.role_id,rp.permission_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.role_permissions rp)
 )::text,'UTF8')),'hex'))
